create_mnist_dataset: create a MNIST dataset pipeline with configurable batch size, shuffling, and multi-device support
create_imagenet_dataset: create an ImageNet dataset pipeline with stateless data augmentations and configurable image size
build_imagenet_preprocess: build image preprocessing for ImageNet with random cropping, flipping, and color distortion
test_imagenet_num_examples: test the number of examples returned for a given ImageNet split string
run_fold_integer_seed: run seed folding to generate per-process random seeds from a base seed and process index
